files.scripts/copy_dumps.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
shopt -s dotglob
src=$1
dst=$2
mkdir -p "$dst"
for file in "$src"/*.dump; do
  if [ -f "$file" ] && [ -s "$file" ]; then cp -- "$file" "$dst/$(basename "$file")"; fi
done
